description: Best pose has CCC 0.82 and MapQ 0.74 but 3 severe clashes and ligand strain 18 kcal/mol — geometrically implausible despite map fit.

expected_decision.rationale: Map-fit is high but chemistry is broken. The current pose is overfit to density. Rerun docking with greater diversity to find a chemically plausible pose before accepting.

notes: Acceptable alternates: analyse_ligand_strain to confirm, then increase_docking_diversity.
